text:
Sam: quick heads-up — pre-prod smoke test for Acadia private deploy failed for audit pipeline. Splunk shows events but decrypted as "UNREADABLE".
Rhea: looked at S3 objects, prefix is correct (acadia/audit/) but KMS-encryption header indicates key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:999888777666:key/abcd1234 and the PutObject was denied with "KMS:Decrypt not authorized".
Diego: hmm customer wanted HSM-protected key; if key is in their KMS account we need cross-account key policy granting our ingestion role. Do they want us to AssumeRole or have their key allow us via kms:GenerateDataKey only?
Maya: customer secops insisted no cross-account AssumeRole for decrypt ops. They requested we sign logs with an envelope key so we never hold plaintext.
ingest-bot: alert: put-error-rate spike for acct-acadia at 03:12 UTC. Error sample: "AccessDenied: KMS key policy denies cryptographic operations".
Sam: that policy constraint creates a go-live risk; they asked about renewal if this drags on. Marking renewal-risk: high.
Rhea: immediate workaround — configure S3 server-side-encryption to use aws:kms with a customer-managed key that has a policy allowing the role arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/RedwoodIngestRole kms:GenerateDataKey only. That avoids decrypt on our side.
Diego: I'll draft a minimal key policy snippet and a PR to our runbook repo. Proposed snippet:
```
{
  "Sid": "AllowRedwoodGenerateDataKey",
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/RedwoodIngestRole"},
  "Action": ["kms:GenerateDataKey*","kms:Encrypt"],
  "Resource": "*"
}
```
Maya: also need change to our collector config: set s3.put_object_encryption=aws:kms and s3.kms_key_id=<customer-key-id> and disable decrypt step.
Sam: ops plan: 1) Diego posts key policy + runbook diff by EOD; 2) Maya validates collector config in staging by 10:00PT; 3) Rhea to get secops approval and sign-off on envelope key approach.
Diego: filing jira CS-2041 for the single canonical runbook and tagging RW-SEC; adding checklist items: cross-account key policy, s3 endpoint, vpc endpoint policy, retention note.
Maya: customer asked for fallback: buffer to an encrypted SQS dead-letter in their account if PutObject fails, with 7-day retention. I'll add template.
Sam: sentiment: "we need a single doc + a pre-cutover checklist, otherwise we'll pause renewal". Please capture in renewal tracker and notify AM.
Rhea: scheduled a 30m secops sync for tomorrow 09:30PT, invite sent to acadia-secops.
ingest-bot: info: after collector tweak in staging, put success climbed from 76% to 99% for sample events.
Sam: thanks team. We'll reconvene post-secops. :white_check_mark:
